programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: June 6, 1944... Operation Overlord was a colossal undertaking. 150,000 Allied Forces landed on five beaches in Normandy, France. The American Forces would then advance to Brittany, the banks of the Loire, and Paris, but they were wrong!
